slices.focus: A chaotic field trip exposes the program's operational fragility, shaking Colleen's confidence but also clarifying where to reinforce.
slices.summary: A volunteer cancellation plus one guide ignoring the route card plus a closed gallery area creates a visibly chaotic school visit. The teacher says she won't rebook without a tighter plan. Colleen feels rattled but distinguishes between program concept (sound, kids were engaged) and delivery system (fragile). She plans a degraded-mode route for reduced staffing, a blocked-area alternate path, and a firmer volunteer meeting about nonnegotiables.
open_loops: Short apology note to teacher tonight -- acknowledging without overpromising
Degraded-mode plan for reduced staffing -- needs drafting before volunteer meeting
Volunteer noncompliance: route adherence as nonnegotiable for school visits
decisions: Colleen's fall school-program push took a credibility hit after a chaotic field-trip day exposed how fragile the museum'
